title: GridMind Machine Knowledge Specification
quality_rule: 1000 means 1000 distinct, evidence-backed industrial equipment archetypes, not manufacturer variants, capacity variants, efficiency labels, or adjective-generated duplicates.
production_rule: A machine-specific diagnostic may be enabled only when its evidence requirements, measurement mapping, placement guidance, calibration/verification requirements, logic, suppression conditions, and validation status are complete.

completeness_levels.L1: process, operating principle, states, components and engineering envelope
completeness_levels.L2: measurements, data sources, sensor/device mapping, placement zones, sampling and signal requirements
completeness_levels.L3: calibration/verification, commissioning, data-quality rules, operating context and performance-reference method
completeness_levels.L4: failure modes, diagnostic questions, evidence requirements, diagnostic logic, uncertainty, thresholds, suppression and actions
completeness_levels.L5: validated against authoritative documentation and/or controlled GridMind test evidence, with intervention and savings-verification workflow

measurement_schema.placement_zone: Engineering measurement zone; exact mounting point is site/manufacturer specific

diagnostic_schema.question: The engineering question GridMind is trying to answer
diagnostic_schema.operating_state: State in which the diagnostic is valid
diagnostic_schema.validation_step: What must be checked before confirmation

safety_boundary: GridMind may identify required measurements, validate data and manage evidence. Physical installation, electrical isolation, wiring, hazardous-area work and safety-critical intervention remain subject to manufacturer instructions, site procedures and qualified personnel.
provenance_rule: Every machine-specific threshold, placement recommendation, diagnostic claim and calculation must have a traceable source or explicit validation evidence.
